spells.name: Bane
spells.details: Oath spell. Up to three creatures make a Charisma save or subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.details: Oath spell. Mark a creature and deal +1d6 damage whenever you hit it with a weapon attack.

spells.name: Bless
spells.details: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

spells.name: Command
spells.details: One-word command. Target makes a Wisdom save or follows it on its next turn.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.details: Bonus Action. A creature gains +2 AC for up to 10 minutes.

attacks:
Longsword — +5 to hit — 1d8 + 3 slashing — Versatile (1d10 + 3), Divine Smite eligible
Javelin — +5 to hit — 1d6 + 3 piercing — Thrown 30/120, Divine Smite eligible in melee only
Light Crossbow — +2 to hit — 1d8 piercing — Range 80/320, loading, two-handed
featuresTraits:
Build Direction: Exiled Vengeance Paladin
- Level 3 guest PC built as a shield-bearing paladin who punishes tyrants and protects people crushed by the Iron Crescent.
- Standard-array build assumed until custom rolls are provided.

Fighting Style: Defense
- While wearing armor, gain +1 AC.

Divine Sense (3 uses)
- Action: detect celestials, fiends, undead, and consecrated or desecrated places within 60 ft.
- Uses = 1 + Charisma modifier per long rest.

Lay on Hands (15 HP pool)
- Action: heal from a pool equal to 5 x paladin level.
- Spend 5 HP from the pool to cure one disease or neutralize one poison.

Divine Smite
- When you hit with a melee weapon attack, spend a spell slot to deal radiant damage.
- 1st-level slot: +2d8 radiant, or +3d8 against undead or fiends.

Spellcasting
- Spell Save DC: 12.
- Spell Attack: +4.
- Prepared paladin spells assumed: Bless, Command, Shield of Faith.
- Oath spells always prepared: Bane and Hunter's Mark.

[Quick] Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy (1 use)
- Action: one creature within 60 ft makes a Wisdom save.
- On failure, it is frightened for 1 minute and its speed becomes 0.
- On success, its speed is halved for 1 minute.
- Refreshes on a short or long rest.

[Quick] Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity (1 use)
- Bonus Action: choose one creature within 10 ft.
- Gain advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 HP or falls unconscious.
- Refreshes on a short or long rest.

Oath Theme
- Kian's oath is not to a throne. It is to the people of the Saffron Coast and to everyone the Iron Crescent tried to silence.
- His test is whether vengeance can remain justice instead of becoming another banner for control.

backstory:
Kian Mehravan was born on the Saffron Coast, a homeland of sea wind, saffron markets, poetry, gardens, and old civic rites. Then the Iron Crescent seized power and called it purification. They claimed to defend faith and national virtue, but their rule became patrols, prisons, forced confessions, and fear.

Their first and most visible targets were women who refused to lower their eyes. Veil Patrols stopped women in streets and markets to inspect headscarves, hair, sleeves, voices, and who they walked beside. A loose scarf became rebellion. A public song became corruption. A student protest became treason. Women were dragged into wagons for correction while officials preached that cruelty was protection.

Kian's family resisted by hiding fugitives, smuggling prison names out of the coast, and exposing what the Iron Crescent did behind sacred banners. The Crescent answered with arrests, executions, threats against families, and confessions beaten into people before public display. Kian escaped because others stayed behind to buy him time.

Now he gathers strength in exile. He does not want a throne for its own sake. He wants enough power, allies, and proof to return to the Saffron Coast and break the Iron Crescent's hold. His greatest fear is not death. It is that hatred will make him into another man with soldiers, slogans, and prisons.
notes: Guest PC. Assumes standard-array Human Paladin until rolled stats or a different ancestry are provided.
